name: sightings
title: Drops we have watched happen
description: Every item we have personally seen drop, the mob it came from, and how many times. Parsed from our own combat logs.

terms.summary: Use it, credit EQL Source, and read the provenance before you trust a value.
terms.measured: The measured data — drop sightings, damage figures, spell lists — is our own parsed play. Freely usable with attribution.
terms.inherited: Fields sourced from community wikis carry their tier and source. Those values are not ours to license; respect the original source and do not present a tier 5 figure as fact.
terms.warranty: None. This is a fan project and the game is actively patched. Every dataset here states what it does not know.
terms.unofficial: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Daybreak Game Company, Game Jawn or Darkpaw Studios.

stability: Fields in a vN file are never removed and never change type.
New optional fields may be added; ignore keys you do not recognise.
A breaking change gets a new version at a new URL. The old one stays up.
Values change as evidence improves. That is the product working, not a breach — watch `hash` if you cache.
notes: A COUNT, NEVER A RATE. A drop seen once is seen once. Nothing here supports a drop-rate claim and we do not make one.
`off_roster` means the mob was named by the log rather than by a survey we had already written.
This is the one dataset in this community that is measured rather than transcribed. It is also the smallest sample. Both are true.
